name: Chartered Capital & Investment Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Chartered Capital And Investment Limited (CCIL) is engaged in  providing consultancy services and merchant banking services to its clients in India.
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is engaged in the financial services sector and more particularly in Merchant Banking activities, inlcuding Issue Management, Underwriting of Issues, delisting & qualified institutions placement and other related non-funding activities.
Company obtained Category I Merchant Banker in 1994 and continues to be registered with SEBI as Category I Merchant Banker since then. Company is also engaged in the investment business.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.54 times its book value
Company has delivered good profit growth of 67.6% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 2.71% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.2.47 Cr.
